head: YouTube Premium account sharing services cut off: Seoul warns buyers
dek: Seoul's city government has warned again about cheap YouTube Premium account-sharing services, after 2,323 complaints this year from buyers who paid upfront and lost access early. Most of them, 1,728, came in October alone.
details: The services add buyers to family plans in other countries or sign them up where YouTube Premium costs less, and YouTube can cut off accounts that break its terms. Buyers had usually paid for six months to two years; many were cut off early, and some companies stopped answering and refused refunds. Two companies made up 88.3% of the complaints, and 90.1% involved bank transfers. An earlier warning from Seoul, on 1 October, counted 202 complaints from January to August.
where: South Korea; account-sharing resellers sold through social media and KakaoTalk chats
means: If a seller offers YouTube Premium far below the official price, you may be buying a spot on someone else's plan that YouTube can shut off at any time, with little chance of a refund.
todo: Buy YouTube Premium through YouTube or an official partner. Don't pay months in advance to a reseller, and walk away from any seller that only takes bank transfers or cash deposits. In Seoul, the Seoul E-Commerce Center lists companies with many complaints.
